scam_patterns.name: Parcel 'payment refund' scam (WhatsApp)
scam_patterns.detail: Suspect ne kaha parcel ka payment refund hoga, 'parcel cancel kara dijiye' pressure, number par refund ka vaada

scam_patterns.name: Fake finance company 'Ram Mudra Finance' — payment liya, service nahi
scam_patterns.detail: 4 din tak 'bank verification', 'mam free hote hi', screenshots maangna — payment ₹ le liya, kaam nahi hua; voice calls no-answer

scam_patterns.name: Fake/banking app + OTP APK (Telegram par '3.5 lakh loan approved' lalch)
scam_patterns.detail: Stolen banking apps beche ja rahe hain (APK) — account takeover ka risk

scam_patterns.name: Phishing SMS + shortlink (fake ₹3,000 VIP gift / bonus)
scam_patterns.detail: cutt.ly shortlink se OTP/credential phishing; sender id fake 'AB 5668 / +66' style

scam_patterns.name: Fake job / task scam (rating + 'registration fee')
scam_patterns.detail: IHCL recruiter bankar 5-star rating ka kaam, ₹375 test-task fee maangi; baad me badi amount

scam_patterns.name: QR code payment trap — ek hi payee ko multiple payments (₹2,000 + ₹3,000)
scam_patterns.detail: Do alag QR/payee par payment; 'this is not my no', 'bye' karke block — R22 staircase pattern

scam_patterns.name: Blackmail / photo-threat (loan recovery style)
scam_patterns.detail: 'Aapki photo family ko bhej dunga', gallery access ki dhamki, WhatsApp par call ka pressure

scam_patterns.name: Fake loan/gang build-up — 'Papa' number + loan app + 'Terri family ma hu abhi Teri'
scam_patterns.detail: Galat number par loan app messages + dhamki

scam_patterns.name: Fake 'foreign parcel' + 'delivery boy' van
scam_patterns.detail: WhatsApp par 'I am delivery boy', 'wait 5 minut', 'wapas vapas kar do' — parcel scam ka doosra set

evidence_notes: Sab screenshots 02 Oct 2026, 21:42–21:55 ko liye gaye (screenshot filename se) — same device, ek hi session me collect kiye.
Kuch screenshots me '+91 9XXXXX' masked hai — screenshot lene wale ke phone me full number save/visible hai; NCRP form me full number daalna chahiye.
QR se UPI ID decode hui: 7349XXXXX6@ptaxis — ye complaint ka sabse strong evidence hai (bank/PSP isko trace kar sakta hai).
Har evidence file ka SHA-256 hash annexure me hai (chain-of-custody ke liye) — dobara koi file badle to hash match nahi hoga.
immediate_actions: 1930 par call karo — turant (golden hour). Transaction ID/UTR ready rakho.
cybercrime.gov.in par 'Report Cyber Financial Fraud' file karo, acknowledgement number save karo.
NCRP 'Suspect Repository Search' me dono UPI IDs / numbers daal kar check karo.
PhonePe app me dono transactions par Help/Report Issue — 'money transferred to fraud' dispute raise karo.
Apne bank ko likhit complaint bhejo (RBI limited-liability framework ka reference) + card/UPI block karwao.
Scammer ko block karo, aur jo bhi screenshots/chats hain — delete NA karo (evidence).
Fake job/loan ke jhoothe vaade band karo; aur kisi bhi 'registration fee' ka payment mat karo (already paid ka refund sirf official process se).
Telecom: us number ko report karo (Sanchar Saathi https://sancharsaathi.gov.in) taaki number block ho.
